---
title: "ukhsa_data_analysis"
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
I selected rate of total antibiotic consumption
```{r}
antibiotics <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")

gt(head(antibiotics))

```
```{r}
ggplot(antibiotics, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("DID (standard consumption)") +
  ggtitle("Rate of total antibiotic consumption")

```
